title: Kth Largest Element in a Stream
summary: Initialize a score stream with nums and a fixed rank k.

contractDetails.constraints: Initial length and number of add calls are each at most 10,000. The initial array may be empty. The rank is from 1 through the initial length plus one. Scores are integers in [−10,000, 10,000].

statement: Initialize a score stream with nums and a fixed rank k. Each add call inserts one score and returns the k-th largest score among all scores seen so far. Count equal scores separately. The fixture calls add for each value in adds from left to right and collects every return value.

examples.explanation: The second-largest score changes after each addition.
Rank one keeps the maximum seen so far.
All copies of 5 occupy separate positions.

constraints: Initial length and number of add calls are each at most 10,000. The initial array may be empty. The rank is from 1 through the initial length plus one. Scores are integers in [−10,000, 10,000].
hints: Conceptual: A low score can be discarded once at least k scores exceed it.
Directional: Retain the k largest scores in a min-priority queue so the smallest retained score is accessible.
Implementation: Insert each score, remove the minimum if the queue grows past k, and return the minimum remaining score.
complexityAnalysis: O(log(k+1)) time per insertion and O(k) space. Building by inserting m initial values takes O(m log(k+1)) time.
